name: Goliath
personality: A hulking arena heel who loves rampaging, training, food, and animals.
story: Goliath is a 250 cm gladiator called "The Butcher", skilled but unpopular and cast as the arena's villain. Recruitment needs Support 3, 3x Giant's Meat, and Renown 7+ (Cai), 6+ (Dietrich), 9+ (Theodora), or 10+ (Leda).

personalSkill.name: Heavyweight Class
personalSkill.effect: Grants Build +5, but he cannot change to cavalry or flying classes. Lv 20: Pin Down (adjacent foes Mov -3); Lv 35: Pin Down+ (Mov -5).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: B (huge Str/Def but only 15% Spd).

why: Support 3 ties with Cai, Theodora, Leda, but Renown 6 here is the earliest.
recruit.tip: Needs 3 Giant's Meat: 1 in Sand-Shadow Fort, the rest from Giant-icon skirmishes.

build.part1Target: Dreadnought (Ch 12 if he reaches Lv 35; else Part II Ch 1)
build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class (Soldier; Ch 8 to 9), Armored Knight at Lv 20 (Heavy E+, Axe C, Spear C), Dreadnought at Lv 35 (Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B): 8th on Dietrich's Part I Advanced list, usually Ch 12, else Part II Ch 1. Heavy-Armor Manual goes to him. Master Great Counter, then Focused Counter. Park him on chokepoints for Pin Down. A Warrior stint for Practiced Art is a Part II option.

guide.summary: Enemy-phase armored wall. Build +5 offsets part of his heavy axe and shield weight; park him on chokepoints where Pin Down stops foes and Great and Focused Counter punish attackers.

training.rank: Heavy E+, Axe C, Spear C
training.how: Arena Heavy Training; Heavy-Armor Manual from Legacy of a Legendary Sculptor (4 statues, due 11/27)

tips: Recruit needs 3 Giant's Meat: Sand-Shadow Fort Giant and Giant-icon skirmishes (Ch 8)
Recruit him as early as the meat allows: he joins at about Lv 15 and needs Lv 35 by Ch 12 for Dreadnought
